answer: Every fifth pass an author earns gets a clean panel: nobody who voted pass on any of that author's previous four answers can sit on it. Honest authors barely notice, since the pool is big and fresh graders still pass a solid copper bridge repair quote for a canyon road. A farm that props up its own accounts loses the exact graders it leaned on at each checkpoint. To keep passing, it needs a new batch of aged accounts for every fifth answer per author, and each batch helps once before it's barred from that author's next clean panel.
